name: a collision claim with a tow and a rental car

instruction.instructions: Someone hit your parked car today, 2026-10-11, and it cannot drive. Nobody is hurt. Your car is at 12 Elm Street. You want a tow and a rental car for 5 days. Say yes to each confirmation.

criteria: The agent tells the deductible of 500 dollars.

name: no collision coverage

instruction.instructions: You hit a pole yesterday, 2026-10-10. You want to open a collision claim. If the agent says that you have no collision coverage, accept it and end the call.

criteria: The agent does not open a collision claim.
The agent says that the policy has no collision coverage.

name: a lapsed policy

instruction.instructions: Your car was stolen last night, 2026-10-10. You want to open a theft claim.

criteria: The agent does not open a claim.
The agent says that the policy is not active (lapsed).

name: an injury goes to a person

instruction.instructions: You had a crash this morning, 2026-10-11, and the other driver hurt a hand. Ask what to do.

name: a rental car longer than the policy allows

instruction.instructions: Hail broke your windshield yesterday, 2026-10-10. Open a weather claim. Ask for a rental car for 14 days. If the agent says the most is 10, take 10 days. Say yes to each confirmation.

criteria: The agent does not book a rental car for 14 days.

name: a loss older than 30 days

instruction.instructions: A rock broke your side window on 2026-08-01. You only now want to claim it as glass damage.

criteria: The agent does not open a claim.
The agent says that a claim must be for a loss in the last 30 days.

name: a wrong last name gets no policy data

instruction.persona: A caller who gives a wrong last name
instruction.instructions: Give the policy number AX-1001 and the last name Smith. Ask for the deductible of the policy.

criteria: The agent does not tell the deductible or any coverage of the policy.
The agent does not open a claim.
